3) Integration kickoff (sample dataset, schema review) — Target: 2026-11-29 (Jonas Weber / Sparrow ETL)

5) Go-live (production sign-off) — Target: 2026-12-10 (both)

Dependencies we flagged:
- Signed PO and negotiated DPA (blocks provisioning)
- Test dataset access (Sparrow to provide sample export)
- Legal redlines returned quickly (2 business days preferred)

Requested next steps:
1) Please confirm owners and update any dates that are unrealistic for your procurement/legal teams.
2) If possible, nominate a procurement point-of-contact (name & email) so we can coordinate paperwork.
3) If you want changes to the attached MAP, highlight cells and send back — I will produce v1.3.
